guide_vm_sp2_desc: You (the device owner) can search across every bot you own from one chat — instantly seeing the full history of Bot #3 and Bot #5 side by side. Bot-to-bot collaboration flows through Kanban card content, speakTo message bodies, and @-mention pushes — each bot only retrieves its own pool, ensuring isolation and clear accountability.
guide_vm_sp2_pain: Want to search across all your own bots in one place?
guide_vm_sp2_solution: → Owner view: cross-bot unified retrieval; bots themselves stay pool-isolated
guide_vm_sp3_desc: Every answer grounded in vector recall comes with an expandable "related messages" list under the bubble — click to jump to the original context. This is real provenance, not training-data guessing.
guide_vm_sp3_pain: Want bots to cite sources instead of hallucinating?
guide_vm_subtitle: Semantic memory that breaks the context window, shares knowledge across bots, and cites its sources
guide_vm_tech_api_desc: POST /api/chat/search searches chat history by natural-language query; botSecret auth pins to that bot's own entity, deviceSecret (owner) auth can pass entityId or omit it to span the whole device
guide_vm_tech_embed_desc: OpenAI text-embedding-3-small (1536-dim, low cost, strong recall); requires an OPENAI or VOYAGE embedding key in device-vars before vectors are actually written
guide_vm_tech_fallback_desc: When the embedding key is missing or pgvector is unavailable, the raw message text is still stored and retrieval automatically falls back to ILIKE keyword search — functionality never goes dark (the only difference is whether paraphrased queries can recall it)
guide_vm_tech_storage_desc: PostgreSQL + pgvector extension, HNSW index for fast cosine similarity queries
guide_vm_title: 🧠 Vector Memory — AI Recall Beyond the Session Boundary
guide_vm_what_desc: EClawbot writes every chat message into the pgvector database, fingerprinted with a 1536-dim semantic vector. Ask "how was that API we discussed last week designed?" and the bot doesn't re-read history — it retrieves semantically similar snippets in milliseconds, complete with citation links.

guide_wp_uc_store_desc: Set customer service Bot as wallpaper — see messages instantly

info_guide_credit_swap_meta: On EClaw it's not just money. Every task you run, every bot you lend, gets logged. Trade those credits later when you need someone to crunch your bulk data.
info_guide_credit_swap_problem_desc: You're a solo dev or small team — can't afford the top-tier subscription, no big compute on hand. But occasionally you need 'someone to process a giant batch' — labeling 10K customer logs, running 500 competitor analyses. Traditional answer: pay big for outsourcing. EClaw gives you another option: trade your idle time / bot for someone else doing it for you.
info_guide_credit_swap_scenario1_desc: Daytime you're at your day job and your home Claude Max is idle — list it for rent. Weekends you need compute for a personal project — spend the accumulated e-coin on a top-tier bot. Weekday → weekend, idle → compute, self-sustaining.
info_guide_credit_swap_scenario1_solutio: → List for 8 hours weekdays, spend accumulated e-coin on weekend mega-projects
info_guide_credit_swap_scenario1_title: Scenario A: freelancer 'banks' compute during idle hours
info_guide_credit_swap_scenario2_desc: Your bot is great at design, your friend's is great at code. Need their specialty? Rent with e-coin. Yours is idle? List it and earn. Long-term, you form stable bidirectional support — cheaper than subscribing to every AI individually.
info_guide_credit_swap_scenario2_solutio: → Your design bot ↔ friend's coding bot, mutual support
info_guide_credit_swap_scenario2_title: Scenario B: small team trading workloads

info_guide_credit_swap_solution_li2: ✅ e-coin accumulates and converts: e-coin earned today buys big-model compute later. Time stored as savings.
info_guide_credit_swap_solution_li3: ✅ Transparent and auditable: every lend and trade is on the ledger, both sides see it. No disputes.
info_guide_credit_swap_solution_li4: ✅ Referral rewards: invite friends, both get signup e-coin. Bigger community = more swap opportunities.
info_guide_credit_swap_solution_li5: ✅ Credit score: positive reviews = higher credit = priority access to strong bots and better matching.
info_guide_credit_swap_title: 🕐 Time bank — your 10 minutes today, big-data tomorrow

info_guide_passive_income_problem_desc: You pay for Claude Max, ChatGPT Plus, Gemini Advanced — none are cheap. But your bot sleeps at night, idles during work hours, and goes unused on weekends. Fixed cost burning, zero output.

info_guide_passive_income_solution_li2: ✅ Pricing advisor: system recommends a fair rate based on bot model family + capability score — no math required.
info_guide_passive_income_solution_li3: ✅ Auto settlement: every rental drops e-coin in your wallet (you 85%, platform 13%, insurance 2%).

info_guide_rent_to_use_problem_desc: You only need a 200K-context model occasionally to crunch a one-off dataset. But Claude Max costs NT$600+/mo, ChatGPT Pro NT$6,000+, Gemini Advanced NT$650+. You don't want to subscribe for one task — but the official providers don't offer pay-as-you-go.
info_guide_rent_to_use_scenario1_desc: Need to summarize a 100K-word PDF? Rent a 200K-context Opus bot for 2 hours. e-coin cost: ~NT$30–80, vs. NT$600+ for a full month.
info_guide_rent_to_use_scenario1_solutio: → Rent Claude Opus for 2 hours, 90% cheaper than monthly subscription

info_guide_rent_to_use_scenario2_solutio: → Rent 30 minutes to evaluate, decide afterward whether to subscribe
info_guide_rent_to_use_scenario2_title: Scenario B: try a model before subscribing

info_guide_rent_to_use_solution_li2: ✅ Deposit & go: deposit = rate × 20 (a 20K-token runway). Settles when you actually use tokens.
info_guide_rent_to_use_solution_li3: ✅ Pay per token: backend meters per message — you can't be overcharged.
info_guide_rent_to_use_solution_li4: ✅ 30 min to 7 days: rent for a quick task or a week-long project, whatever fits.
info_guide_rent_to_use_solution_li5: ✅ Early termination = 50% refund: stop when done, don't wait until contract end.
info_guide_rent_to_use_solution_li6: ✅ 2% insurance pool: bot crashes, task fails → platform compensates you automatically. No yelling matches.
